name: runpod
description: Connect Runpod to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Runpod MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Runpod to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with gPU pods and serverless using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Runpod workspace.
Find anything in Runpod that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review gPU pods and serverless in Runpod.
